title: The Delaware River at Philadelphia
caption: Looking west from Camden toward Philadelphia, April 2025. A present-day view of the river landscape; it does not reconstruct Lenape settlements.

title: Independence Hall — historic postcard
caption: Historic postcard of Independence Hall; date not recorded. This later depiction is not a view of the Declaration’s adoption in 1776.

title: The Constitution — first page
caption: First page of the Constitution of the United States, signed in 1787. The document supplies the visual evidence for this reading about governmental structure.

title: The President’s House — memorial to the enslaved
caption: The Memorial to the Enslaved at the President’s House site, photographed in June 2022. A place of remembrance connected to Ona Judge’s story, not a portrait of her.

title: Mother Bethel A.M.E. Church
caption: The surviving Mother Bethel church, photographed in 2014. This is a later building in the congregation’s history, not its original converted blacksmith’s shop.

title: The Centennial Exhibition opens
caption: Published illustration of opening-day ceremonies at Philadelphia’s Centennial Exhibition, May 10, 1876. Historical artwork rather than a photograph.

title: Independence Hall’s tower
caption: The tower of Independence Hall viewed from the south in 2017. Its appearance provides a starting point for examining alteration and restoration.

title: The Liberty Bell and national memory
caption: The Liberty Bell displayed across from Independence Hall, October 2016. A present-day symbol for the reading’s question about what an anniversary should remember.
